transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Lucy. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hello Lucy, mera network signal bahut kharab hai. I am not getting any calls on my phone 93184 43959.
Agent: I need your account number to check the status. Please provide it.
Customer: My account number is 11527375 and my name is Vivek Das.
Agent: One moment. I am checking the network coverage in your area.
Customer: Please jaldi karo, it is very frustrating. I have been facing this for three days now.
Agent: The system shows the network is working fine in your location.
Customer: Kya baat kar rahe ho? Signal bilkul nahi hai! I am paying for a service that I am not getting.
Agent: The system is correct. You should restart your device.
Customer: Maine restart kar liya hai multiple times. This is ridiculous. I want a solution right now!
Agent: There is nothing more I can do from my end if the system shows no outage.
Customer: This is the worst service ever. Main switch kar raha hoon, I will port out to another provider immediately.
Agent: Is there anything else I can assist you with today? I have checked your account and found no issues. Goodbye.
